description: The plain optional contains a one-item route and a flat-brace route. The optional contains no capture. The present route reads the D tokens and then the written T, so .tags(r) returns the empty set (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input :: $r.tags(r)
%rule input B {D} T
%rule r :: Queried | B [(c | {c})] [+T] D T
%rule c D
